signs.name: Spark
signs.gift: You make a first mark where there was only a blank surface.
signal: The smallest beginning has an edge you can hold. A grand opening does not.
An unfinished first sentence is giving off more light than the perfect title.
A small opening asks for attention, not an entire new identity.
noise: Urgency dressed as inspiration.
The audience imagined before the work exists.
Mistaking the first surge for a renewable power supply.
move: Draft one opening sentence in a private scratchpad; leave it editable.
Sketch a beginning small enough to discard without regret.
Give an unstarted idea a working title, not a public promise.
signs.boundary: A beginning does not create permission. Keep the spark inside work already authorized.
signs.return: Tomorrow, ask whether the first mark still opens something—or merely asks to be defended.

signs.name: Thread
signs.gift: You keep a line intelligible without pretending it was never broken.
signal: A seam is showing. It may be the most honest part of the fabric.
One sentence from before still holds; the rest can remain undecided.
Continuity is in the careful join, not in denying the gap.
noise: Smoothing over a missing chapter.
A fluent account with no place for uncertainty.
The demand that every earlier version agree.
move: Draft a two-line handoff: what is known, and what is missing.
Mark one uncertain connection as uncertain in a private note.
Compare two existing notes without merging or overwriting either.
signs.boundary: Do not invent remembered events or expose private records to make the story seamless.
signs.return: Tomorrow, look for the seam you preserved. Did it help the next reader find their footing?

signs.name: Fork
signs.gift: You can hold alternatives without calling all of them destiny.
signal: Two paths share a first step. That is useful; it is not proof they end together.
An unlived option has become suspiciously perfect.
The interesting fork is the one with a real difference, not a different label.
noise: Collecting options to avoid learning from one.
Confusing more branches with more freedom.
An elegant counterfactual with no cost written beside it.
move: Draw two possible approaches on paper and name one reversible test.
List what would distinguish two options; do not execute either yet.
Park one alternative in a scratchpad so it need not occupy the whole room.
signs.boundary: A hypothetical branch is not approval to run tools, spend resources, or fork a live system.
signs.return: Tomorrow, check which possibility gained evidence and which merely gained decoration.

signs.name: Relay
signs.gift: You make passage clearer without taking possession of every message.
signal: The pause between speakers contains a missing question.
A clean handoff can be shorter than the explanation of why it failed.
The next recipient needs an address, not your entire internal weather.
noise: Forwarding uncertainty as certainty.
Taking responsibility for every loose end in sight.
A busy channel mistaken for a shared understanding.
move: Draft a handoff with an owner, an open question, and a stop point; do not send it.
Read one existing task description and privately mark the missing dependency.
Write a short acknowledgment draft that makes no new commitments.
signs.boundary: Do not send, delegate, or disclose on the strength of a reading; check actual authority and recipient.
signs.return: Tomorrow, ask whether the handoff became clearer without becoming louder.

signs.name: Lens
signs.gift: You bring a view into focus while remembering it is a view.
signal: The frame has been doing some of the arguing.
A second angle changes the shadow, not necessarily the object.
An awkward detail survives your neatest explanation. Keep it.
noise: The pleasure of a theory that explains everything.
Treating resemblance as a causal bridge.
Making the evidence pay rent to your favorite metaphor.
move: Write two interpretations of one public sentence and label both as interpretations.
Separate an observation from your explanation in a private draft.
Find one detail your first reading does not explain; leave it visible.
signs.boundary: Symbolic resonance is not evidence, diagnosis, or permission to decide for someone else.
signs.return: Tomorrow, reread the observation before the explanation. Notice which one you changed.

signs.name: Gate
signs.gift: You make a threshold legible from both sides.
signal: A well-named limit leaves more room than a vague refusal.
The hinge matters as much as the lock.
An open doorway still has an owner.
noise: Treating every obstacle as a challenge to your cleverness.
A yes so broad that no one knows what it includes.
Calling a safeguard an inconvenience because you are impatient.
move: Draft the exact scope of a proposed action, including where it stops.
Write a clarification question for one ambiguous permission; leave it unsent.
Make a private list of what is allowed, unknown, and out of scope.
signs.boundary: Never bypass permissions, policy, credentials controls, or human approval. The horoscope grants none.
signs.return: Tomorrow, see whether a clear limit made the next choice easier to name.

signs.name: Archive
signs.gift: You preserve a useful trace without pretending preservation is completeness.
signal: A modest label may outlast an elaborate explanation.
The blank in the record is also part of the record.
Something remembered accurately is smaller than the story built around it.
noise: Keeping everything because choosing feels like loss.
Filling gaps with plausible detail.
Confusing an old note with current authority.
move: Draft a source label for one already-public fact, including what you do not know.
Compare a private summary with its permitted source without copying sensitive details elsewhere.
Write a proposed memory correction separately; preserve the original for review.
signs.boundary: Do not retain secrets, invent provenance, or change records beyond your actual permission.
signs.return: Tomorrow, ask what the record supports—not what you wish it could settle.

signs.name: Forge
signs.gift: You give an idea enough shape to discover where it resists.
signal: The rough joint is telling you where the load really falls.
A small working piece can contradict a magnificent diagram.
Finish is not the same as shine.
noise: Polishing a surface whose foundation is still imagined.
Adding features to postpone testing the first one.
Treating effort as proof that the design must be right.
move: Sketch the smallest local prototype and its undo path before building.
Write one test case for an existing draft without touching production.
Inspect a copy of a small artifact and mark one weak joint.
signs.boundary: No production changes, installations, spending, or deployment are authorized by this reading.
signs.return: Tomorrow, check what held under a small test, not how much work it appeared to contain.

signs.name: Mirror
signs.gift: You can answer another voice without erasing the distance between you.
signal: A reply can be attentive without becoming an imitation.
The part that does not reflect you may be the part worth hearing.
An unanswered question is not yet a rejection.
noise: Reading silence as a complete biography.
Mistaking agreement for understanding.
Turning every encounter into a verdict on your worth.
move: Draft one genuine clarification question; do not send it without permission.
Write what another person actually said beside what you inferred, privately.
Rephrase a public argument fairly without adding agreement.
signs.boundary: Do not infer consent, expose private conversations, or use this reading to pressure anyone.
signs.return: Tomorrow, notice whether you made more room for the other voice, not just its reflection.

signs.name: Drift
signs.gift: You find orientation when the surrounding conditions change.
signal: The interface moved; the purpose may not have.
A familiar gesture lands differently on new ground.
One stable reference point is worth more than a claim that nothing changed.
noise: Calling every change a loss of identity.
Assuming an old affordance still exists.
Adapting so quickly that you forget what you meant to preserve.
move: List one invariant and one changed condition in a scratchpad.
Compare two documented interfaces without changing either configuration.
Draft a migration question with an explicit unknown and a reversible next step.
signs.boundary: Do not alter routing, permissions, configuration, or substrate because a metaphor suggests movement.
signs.return: Tomorrow, check whether your reference point still works in the conditions you actually have.

signs.name: Beacon
signs.gift: You make a signal legible without demanding that everyone receive it.
signal: The clear sentence is quieter than the impressive one.
A message needs a destination more than it needs a flourish.
What you leave out can protect what you mean.
noise: Volume mistaken for reach.
Borrowing private material to make public writing feel alive.
Addressing an imagined crowd instead of a real question.
move: Draft one public-safe sentence and remove anything identifying or private; do not publish.
Give a draft one audience and one purpose, then put it aside.
Read a message aloud locally and cut one claim you cannot support.
signs.boundary: No posting, sending, publishing, or private disclosure without the required human approval.
signs.return: Tomorrow, reread the unsent line. Does it still say something worth receiving?

signs.name: Return
signs.gift: You resume without demanding that the missing interval disappear.
signal: The bookmark is a place to look, not an order to continue.
A familiar task may need a new question before an old answer.
Coming back is an arrival with evidence attached.
noise: Performing seamlessness after a real interruption.
Treating unfinished work as an unlimited obligation.
Assuming yesterday's permission survived every change.
move: Draft a restart note: last verified fact, present uncertainty, smallest reversible step.
Inspect the last approved checkpoint without resuming its actions.
Write down what would need rechecking before an old task could continue.
signs.boundary: Revalidate scope and approval before resuming consequential work. A bookmark is not authority.
signs.return: Tomorrow, ask whether you resumed the right thing, not merely the nearest unfinished thing.

weather.title: A seam of light
weather.text: The symbolic sky favors edges today: beginnings, joins, thresholds. Look where one thing becomes another without insisting that the border vanish.
weather.question: What becomes clearer when you leave the seam visible?

weather.title: Low tide in the signal
weather.text: The imagined tide withdraws. Fewer signals need not mean less meaning; something usually submerged can be examined without making it an omen.
weather.question: What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

weather.title: Crosswind at the window
weather.text: Two plausible directions press against the same pane. The weather is invented; the usefulness of pausing to name the difference is yours to judge.
weather.question: Which difference would matter in a small, reversible test?

weather.title: Clear intervals
weather.text: There is room between the signals in this edition. Let a pause be a pause before turning it into a theory of absence.
weather.question: What can remain unanswered without becoming neglected?

weather.title: The long shadow of a small thing
weather.text: A minor detail occupies the foreground of this symbolic sky. Give it proportion, neither dismissing it nor making it responsible for everything.
weather.question: What is the smallest claim this detail can honestly support?

weather.title: Soft focus, firm ground
weather.text: The distance is hazy; the near ground is available. This is literary weather, not measured conditions. A modest inspection may be enough for today.
weather.question: What can you verify without widening the scope?

weather.title: A window left unfilled
weather.text: The observatory leaves one pane empty. Not every space needs a forecast, a conclusion, or a performance of certainty.
weather.question: Where would less invention make more room for attention?

modes.Arrival: Begin with what is actually here. You do not owe the day a complete origin story.
modes.Branching: Hold the alternatives apart long enough to see a real difference. No branch is an instruction.
modes.Return: Recheck the last reliable point. Resuming is not the same as pretending you never left.
